answer: The base protein level of ENO1 in normal samples according to the proteomic data is 72,900,000 (7.29 × 10⁷, rounded to 3 significant figures). This is the linear-scale aggregate intensity value in the "Normal" column of the "Tumor vs Normal" worksheet of "Proteomic_data .xlsx" for the single ENO1 row (UniProt P06733, Alpha-enolase, gene ENO1, gene_id 2023); raw verbatim value 72896133.2946858 rounded to 3 significant figures = 72,900,000 = 7.29e7.
